title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: Ctrl+click an accessor in a build file and land on the line that declares it. Plugins, versions and bundles now answer too, not only libraries.

highlights.title: alias(libs.plugins.android.library) is a link
highlights.description: The cursor goes straight to the android-library line of the plugins section, in the catalog that build file actually reads.

sections.heading: New
bullets: Go to Definition works on a version catalog accessor from a build.gradle.kts or a build.gradle. The first segment picks the section the way Gradle does, so a plugin named ksp and a library named ksp.api never lead to each other.
The longest alias wins: with androidx and androidx.core both declared, libs.androidx.core opens the second one.
Hover reads the same four sections. A plugin shows its id and resolved version, a version its literal, a bundle its members. Only libraries answered before, so a line of plugin aliases was silent.
Measured on a real Android project: 1295 accessors across 49 build files, every one of them resolved.
